text:
Vincent Schaefer's co-inventor on the 1947 "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" patent was most likely Irving Langmuir. Langmuir was the Nobel-winning General Electric chemist who led Schaefer's cloud-seeding work, and that matches the team note. This replaces my earlier guess of Bernard Vonnegut. I haven't checked the patent record, so this rests on the note and my recollection.

CONFIDENCE: 80
